name: Ur-Drago
description: A monster created by Terrent Amese to exterminate the tiger tribe; later defeated by Jedit Ojanen.

description_citations.text: "Terrent Amese". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The wizards attack the Woods from three directions; Petalia is lost in the Abyss when Greensleeves banishes Ur-Drago.
timeline.quote: Immediately, the wizards attack the Woods from three different directions.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ten wizards led by Towser and Karli, with Ur-Drago and a Keldon warlord, attack the army from three directions; Greensleeves banishes Ur-Drago, losing Petalia to the Abyss.
timeline.quote: Petalia , captain of her bodyguard, was lost in the Abyss when the druid banished Ur-Drago.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Final sacrifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terrent Amese curses the Ojanen line, creates Ur-Drago to exterminate the tribe, and disappears; Ojanen fights the beast while the tribe flees Scarwood.
timeline.quote: Terrent Amese cursed the Ojanen line and created the monster Ur-Drago to exterminate the tribe before disappearing, never to be seen again.

citation.text: "Terrent Amese", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jedit Ojanen is magically transported to the duel's moment and defeats Ur-Drago himself.
timeline.quote: before Jedit Ojanen would be magically transported to this crucial point in time and defeat Ur-Drago himself.

citation.text: "Terrent Amese", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale Jedit learns the history of the cat warriors and that the ghost was Ojanen's lover; he slays Ur-Drago but is gravely wounded.
timeline.quote: Ur-Drago attacks Jedit and the tiger man manages to slay his foe
